Once You're Ready To Leave The Garden

Six ways to fill the days. Mix to fit however long you're staying.

Full Day · ~7 Hrs

Ol Pejeta Conservancy

17 km / 10.6 mi · ~25 min drive

Big Five game drive, the Sweetwaters Chimpanzee Sanctuary, and a rhino encounter with Baraka. The one most guests build their whole trip around.

Half Day · ~3 Hrs

Mount Kenya Wildlife Conservancy

10 km / 6.2 mi · ~15–20 min drive

Hands-on with bongos, cheetahs, llamas and tortoises at the Animal Orphanage. Gentle pace — good for an arrival evening or the morning you check out.

Half/Full Day · ~5 HrsBook Ahead

Ngare Ndare Forest Reserve

40 km / 25 mi · ~60–75 min drive

A 450m canopy walk through 200-year-old forest, then down to the waterfall and blue pools for a swim. Needs a few days' notice and a 4WD for the final stretch.

Day Walk or 3–5 Day TrekAsk Us

Mt. Kenya National Park — Sirimon Gate

23–28 km / 14–17 mi · ~40–60 min drive

A day walk into the lower forest and moorland, or the full summit trek with permits, guide, porters and camping — arranged separately, well ahead of arrival.

Half Day · ~3 Hrs

Nanyuki Town & Equator

3 km / 1.9 mi · ~5–8 min drive

The Equator Marker's Coriolis demonstration, Cedar Mall, lunch at Barney's, and a stop at One-Stop Nanyuki. Easy, walkable, no booking needed.

~1 Hr · Any Evening

Cycling Around Muthaiga

0 km · leaves from the driveway

Quiet, tree-lined roads right from the driveway. Less a booked activity than a standing offer — ask and we'll have bikes ready.

How Guests Usually Combine These
1 night
Nanyuki Town & Equator, half day — cycling in the evening.
2 nights
Ol Pejeta on day one — Mount Kenya Wildlife Conservancy or Nanyuki Town on the departure morning.
3 nights
Ol Pejeta, Ngare Ndare, and Nanyuki Town & Equator — cycling wherever there's a gap.
4+ nights
All of the above, plus the Sirimon day walk or summit trek — flag this one at booking, not on arrival.
